_README: Expected values for check_baseline.py. Re-measure after any rebase: the base moves underneath us and a carried number is not a measured one. sigma: within-session 0.03% on a, cross-session 0.2-0.4%; treat >1% as a real shift.
_flag_polarity_warning: GEMMA4_PREFILL_L1_ACT IS DEAD on this base and run_e2e.sh now refuses it. gemma4_d_p places short-lived prefill activations in L1 by DEFAULT; the opt-out is GEMMA4_ACTIVATIONS_DRAM_ONLY=1. The pre-rebase configs map across as: old 'L1 off' -> dram_only, old 'mmanzoor_only' -> base.

dram_only._what: activations forced to DRAM -- the true 'before L1 placement' control

base._what: the new base as it ships: L1 activations on, mmanzoor's core_grid / fused GELU / fused layer_scalar all unconditional

_superseded_pre_rebase._note: Measured on base 3bd2c2bbe299-era tree; kept only to show the rebase was perf-neutral. Every cell above reproduced these within +/-0.4%, i.e. inside documented cross-session drift.

_historical_pre_mmanzoor._note: NOT re-measured on the new base -- needs a separate checkout and full rebuild of a now doubly-stale commit. Carried for narrative only; do not compare against the configs above.
